entries.title: Remote Work Policy
entries.content: Our remote work policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 days per week. Employees must maintain regular communication with their team and be available during core business hours (10 AM - 3 PM local time). All remote work arrangements must be approved by your direct supervisor. Equipment and internet connectivity requirements: reliable high-speed internet, company-provided laptop, and access to VPN for secure connections.

entries.title: How to Reset Your Password
entries.content: To reset your password: 1) Go to the login page and click 'Forgot Password'. 2) Enter your email address and click 'Send Reset Link'. 3) Check your email for a password reset link (check spam folder if not found). 4) Click the link and create a new password. Your new password must be at least 8 characters long and include uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters. If you continue to have issues, contact IT support at ext. 1234.

entries.title: Office Hours and Contact Information
entries.content: Our main office hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. The office is closed on weekends and federal holidays. Main phone: (555) 123-4567. Customer support is available 24/7 at (555) 123-HELP or support@company.com. Emergency contact for employees: (555) 123-9999. Office address: 123 Business Ave, Suite 100, Business City, BC 12345.

entries.title: Expense Reimbursement Process
entries.content: To submit expense reimbursements: 1) Keep all original receipts for business expenses. 2) Log into the expense portal within 30 days of the expense. 3) Upload clear photos of receipts and fill out the expense form with business justification. 4) Submit for manager approval. 5) Approved expenses are processed within 5-7 business days. Reimbursable expenses include travel, meals (up to $50/day), office supplies, and client entertainment (pre-approved). Non-reimbursable: personal items, alcohol without clients, excessive meal costs.

entries.title: VPN Setup Instructions
entries.content: To set up VPN access: 1) Download the company VPN client from the IT portal. 2) Install the software and restart your computer. 3) Open the VPN client and enter your employee ID as username. 4) Use your network password (same as email password). 5) Select 'Company Main' as the server. 6) Click Connect. The VPN should connect within 30 seconds. If you see a green lock icon, you're connected. For troubleshooting: ensure your internet is working, try different servers, or contact IT support. VPN is required for accessing internal systems remotely.

entries.title: Product Return Policy
entries.content: Our return policy allows returns within 30 days of purchase for a full refund. Items must be in original condition with all packaging and accessories. Digital products and customized items cannot be returned. To initiate a return: 1) Contact customer service with your order number. 2) Receive a return authorization number (RMA). 3) Package the item securely with the RMA number visible. 4) Ship using the prepaid return label we provide. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive the returned item. Exchanges are also available for different sizes or colors.
